claims.claim_ar: إِنْ هنا مخففة من الثقيلة، والتقدير محذوف بعدها (مثل: «إنه كُنْتُمْ ...») أي وجود تقدير محذوف يتعلق بـإِنْ
claims.claim_en: The particle 'إِنْ' here is in its 'mukhafafa' (lightened) form; an implied (elided) predicate (taqdir) is present (for example: 'إنه كُنتُم ...').
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited explanation in the source treats the example «وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ» and states a general rule about إِنْ being 'مخففة' with an implied تقدير; the source does not quote this specific ayah, so applying the rule to this verse assumes the same usage.

warnings: The quoted passage in the source discusses the particle إِنْ in the example «وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ» (saying it is 'مخففة' and has a تقدير). The source does not explicitly analyze S36:29; the claim applies that general rule to the إِنْ of S36:29 and should be reviewed for direct applicability to this specific verse.
